project: LittleBit-2 P40 OPT-125M held-out validation engineering comparison

protocol.scoring: equal 128-token non-overlapping independent blocks; not standard sliding-window perplexity
evaluated_models: LittleBit-2 Joint-ITQ OPT-125M checkpoint trained for exactly 2 optimizer steps on synthetic text

interpretation: The existing two-step synthetic quantization-aware training smoke checkpoint produced finite outputs but dramatically poorer held-out predictive quality than the original. This is not evidence of quality or effective compression after a proper training run.
caveats: Two synthetic training steps do not produce a converged model.
These are 128-token block scores, not standard published WikiText-2 sliding-window perplexity.
Peak allocated CUDA memory is not full-model effective bits per weight or serving footprint.
No native Strata/Ollama serving integration is demonstrated.
The separate WikiText-2 test split was not accessed in this evaluation.
The results are independent engineering measurements, not Samsung vendor benchmarks.
No model weights, private network details, raw household prompts or vendor source are shared.
